title: Grant a user permissions to pass a role to an AWS service
supports: Passing a role is controlled by iam:PassRole; scope approved roles and services. Passing roles across accounts is not directly supported. PassRole itself is not a separately logged API operation.
does_not_establish: A working escalation path without job permissions, service trust, runtime control and effective data permissions.
scope: bounded source review; not an exhaustive prior-art search

title: CreateTrainingJob API
supports: Training jobs specify RoleArn and require caller PassRole permission. VPC configuration and network isolation are separate settings.
does_not_establish: That every role or training container has broad data access, or that cloud execution was tested here.
scope: bounded source review; not an exhaustive prior-art search

title: Set up authentication between Azure Machine Learning and other services
supports: Job data access can use compute identity, user identity or stored credentials. Compute identity may intentionally read data unavailable directly to a scientist. Autocreated ACR enables its admin account; workspace-kind-specific data isolation defaults differ.
does_not_establish: That managed-identity execution is itself unauthorized, or that these defaults are identical for every workspace creation path.
scope: bounded source review; not an exhaustive prior-art search

title: Use a custom service account
supports: Attaching a custom runtime service account requires actAs. Default custom training and prediction identities differ; prediction defaults should not be assumed to grant general data access. Batch inference data access has a documented service-agent exception.
does_not_establish: Equivalent privileges across Vertex AI modes or a tested project-specific escalation.
scope: bounded source review; not an exhaustive prior-art search
documentation_route_note: Original Vertex AI URL redirected to Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform ML documentation on the review date; resolved route recorded.

title: Service Accounts
supports: Assigned service-account credentials are mounted unless disabled. Modern projected tokens rotate and have binding/audience constraints. Default service accounts have limited default RBAC rights.
does_not_establish: Administrator rights from the default service account or token validity without its checks.
scope: bounded source review; not an exhaustive prior-art search

title: Role Based Access Control Good Practices
supports: Workload creation can expose namespace resources and service-account privileges. Namespace trust separation and least privilege matter.
does_not_establish: Every pod creator can use every identity; admission and other effective controls must be checked.
scope: bounded source review; not an exhaustive prior-art search

title: Network Policies
supports: Ingress and egress isolation are independent. Pods start non-isolated for either direction; applicable allow policies combine. Enforcement requires a supporting network implementation.
does_not_establish: That a policy file is enforced, that it authorizes an application operation, or that behavior is identical for hostNetwork, NAT and existing connections.
scope: bounded source review; not an exhaustive prior-art search

title: Excessive Agency, published 2025 edition
supports: Generic privileged tool identities and insufficient downstream authorization can enable damaging agent actions.
does_not_establish: An LLM attack success rate, new vulnerability class, or the latest OWASP category numbering.
scope: bounded source review; not an exhaustive prior-art search

title: Verifying artifacts, specification v1.1
supports: Artifact verification includes trusted identity, signature, subject digest and expected provenance values.
does_not_establish: That a digest check alone establishes trusted provenance or that this lab implements SLSA verification.
scope: bounded source review; not an exhaustive prior-art search
